clue.text: Governor took place in parliament, talking rhythmically

parts.note: to take your place in a parliament is to have sat there as a member
rap is speech delivered rhythmically over a beat

explanation.surface: A politician takes a seat in the chamber and then speaks in a sing-song way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'took place' here means took a seat, not happened.
explanation.definitionFit: A satrap was a provincial ruler in ancient Persia, so the word means a regional governor.

clue.text: Dish me up Latinate ten? Such is X!

indicators.note: to dish something up is to serve it out reworked, so these letters are served in a new order

parts.note: taken as written: fifteen letters of fodder

explanation.surface: A cook is told to serve a Latin-flavoured dish of ten, as if X marked the spot.
explanation.walkthrough: The word 'up' is part of the fodder, not of the indicator. X, Y, Z are the alphabet's last three letters, so X comes third from the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Antepenultimate means third from last, and X stands in that position before Y and Z.

clue.text: Hostility must be managed on playing area, curtailed

indicators.note: one piece sits on top of the next in a down clue, so the pieces follow in order

parts.note: to have managed a business is to have run it

indicators.note: a curtailed word has lost its tail, its last letter

parts.note: a court is the playing area for tennis or squash

explanation.surface: Bad feeling on a sports field has to be handled before it gets out of hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is bitter, lasting resentment, a form of hostility toward someone.

clue.text: Artist shows doorkeeper holding light pencil

indicators.note: one word holds the other, which sits inside it

parts.note: a porter keeps the door of a college or hotel
a pencil of light is a narrow beam, a ray

explanation.surface: An artist displays a sketch of a doorman made with a soft pencil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pencil' is not a drawing tool here: a pencil of light is a thin beam.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who portrays a subject in paint or on stage is an artist depicting it.

clue.text: Flowery death met with honour in past

indicators.note: the first pieces go inside the word for past

parts.note: by can mean past, as when a car goes by

indicators.note: one piece is joined by the next, side by side

parts.note: a death is a loss to those left behind
OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: A funeral tribute full of flowers marks a death and an honour from long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Something covered in blossom is full of flowers, which is the sense of flowery.

clue.text: What's almost too difficult for church singer

indicators.note: almost the whole word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: something too difficult is beyond you
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A church soloist is told a piece is nearly out of their range.
explanation.definitionFit: Beyoncé is the American pop and R&B star, a world-famous singer.

clue.text: Trump's unacceptable act

parts.note: an idea that is out is not acceptable, ruled out
to do is to act or perform

explanation.surface: It reads as a jibe that a certain president's behaviour is beyond the pale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trump' looks like the politician but is the verb meaning beat.
explanation.definitionFit: To trump a rival is to beat or surpass them, as a trump card beats others.

clue.text: Bone in back — er, it's one at the front!

parts.note: the stern is the back of a ship
um and er are both hesitation noises

explanation.surface: Someone hunting a bone in the back hesitates and realises it is at the front.
explanation.walkthrough: The closing words are a joke: this bone is in the chest, at the front, not in the back.
explanation.definitionFit: The sternum is the breastbone, the flat bone down the front of the chest.

clue.text: Electronic music device that could make rest home so zingy

indicators.note: the letters could be made into something else, rearranged

parts.note: taken as written: fifteen letters of fodder

explanation.surface: A keyboard gadget livens up a sleepy retirement home.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moog synthesizer was an early and famous electronic instrument for making music.

clue.text: Fish to go off course, one no good getting caught

indicators.note: the pieces are caught inside the other word

parts.note: to stray is to wander off course
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An angler's catch drifts off course and a useless one gets hooked.
explanation.definitionFit: A stingray is a flat sea fish with a venomous barbed tail.

clue.text: Fellow who preaches in a Dartmoor location?

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hilltop, typical of Dartmoor, an upland moor in Devon, England
REV, short for Reverend, is a clergyman who preaches

explanation.surface: A man who gives sermons out on the moor.
explanation.definitionFit: Trevor is a man's given name, and crosswords use fellow for any male name.

clue.text: Mate getting into top position

indicators.note: the letters are found by getting into the words that follow, inside them

explanation.surface: A friend climbs into the top spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Oppo is British slang for a colleague or partner, a close mate.

clue.text: Man's snored dreadfully — feature of irregular noise

indicators.note: done dreadfully, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A man's loud, uneven snoring keeps everyone awake.
explanation.definitionFit: Irregular noise has no pattern, and lack of pattern is randomness.

clue.text: Any girl, sadly, won't want one bent like an old man

indicators.note: sadly means badly, so the letters are messed up
the letter for one is not wanted, so it is left out of the mix

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A young woman, sadly, will not fancy a crooked old man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sadly' shuffles ANYGIRL; 'won't want one' means the I is removed from those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnarly means knotted and twisted, like gnarled old fingers or a bent old body.

clue.text: Soldiers in each group will get legal right

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a set is a group of things
men is the usual word for ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops in every unit are granted a legal entitlement.
explanation.definitionFit: An easement is a legal right over someone else's land, such as a right of way.

clue.text: Chemical agents more frequently carried by ship

indicators.note: one piece is carried inside the other

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
oftener is an old comparative of often

explanation.surface: Chemicals get shipped more and more often.
explanation.definitionFit: Water softeners and fabric softeners are chemical agents that soften things.

clue.text: Person admitting deficiency, right person to knock on door

indicators.note: the outer word lets the others in

parts.note: bod is British slang for a person
a lack is a deficiency

explanation.surface: Someone confesses a shortcoming and is then sent to knock on a door.
explanation.walkthrough: Black Rod is the UK parliamentary officer who knocks on the Commons door at the State Opening.
explanation.definitionFit: At the State Opening of Parliament, Black Rod famously bangs on the Commons door to summon MPs.

clue.text: Tin and lead fused in scientific unit

parts.note: a tin is a can

indicators.note: metal that is fused is melted down, so these letters are recast in a new order

explanation.surface: Two metals melted together form something measurable in a lab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tin and lead' look like the metals to be fused, but tin gives CAN and only 'lead' is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The candela is the SI base unit of luminous intensity, used in physics.

clue.text: Avoiding professional expertise to conceal cunning government style

indicators.note: the outer piece conceals the other inside it

parts.note: DIY, do-it-yourself, is doing a job without hiring a professional
arch means sly or knowing

explanation.surface: An amateur administration hides its scheming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Avoiding professional' tempts you to delete PRO; the whole phrase is DIY.
explanation.definitionFit: A diarchy is a system of rule by two joint governors, a form of government.

clue.text: Attack that's kept quiet or loud?

indicators.note: one word keeps the other inside it

parts.note: to flay is to attack savagely, in words or with a whip
sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether an assault was hushed up or noisy.
explanation.definitionFit: Loud can describe garish, showy taste, so loud clothes are flashy ones.

clue.text: Increase of good chaps in a union after upheaval

indicators.note: the first pieces go inside the other
in a down clue an upheaval lifts the letters, so the word reads upwards, backwards

parts.note: TU stands for trade union
men are chaps

explanation.surface: Membership of decent men in a trade union grows after turmoil.
explanation.definitionFit: To augment something is to make it bigger, to increase it.

clue.text: Majority that's associated with a bit of pride?

definitions.text: associated with a bit of pride?
definitions.meaning: a pride is a group of lions, so a bit of it is a portion owned by such beasts

explanation.surface: The bulk of something is linked with a piece of vanity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pride' looks like vanity but is the collective noun for lions.
explanation.definitionFit: The lion's share is the biggest part of something, the majority.

clue.text: Support belief son will rise to the top

indicators.note: in a down clue rising takes the letter up to the start of the word

parts.note: trust is belief or faith

explanation.surface: A father's faith that his boy will get to the top.
explanation.definitionFit: A strut is a bar that braces or supports a structure.

clue.text: My word, a hospital that helps sick children!

definitions.text: a hospital that helps sick children!
definitions.meaning: Great Ormond Street Hospital is London's famous children's hospital, known by its initials

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims with surprise at a hospital that treats children.
explanation.definitionFit: Gosh is a mild exclamation of surprise, just like my word.

clue.text: Run a sequence of jobs

definitions.meaning: a working life, one post after another

explanation.surface: Someone is told to manage a series of tasks.
explanation.definitionFit: To career is to rush headlong, and a career is one's working life of jobs.

clue.text: Race around holding letter finally found at back of study in a cupboard

indicators.note: the outer letters hold the rest inside
the letters are turned around, so re-ordered
one piece is found at the back of the other, after it

parts.note: a den is a private study
Z is the final letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A frantic hunt for a letter ends in a cupboard at the back of the study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letter finally' is not the last letter of 'letter' but the alphabet's final letter; 'Race' looks like a synonym to find but is shuffled as written.
explanation.definitionFit: A credenza is a sideboard or low cabinet, a type of cupboard.

clue.text: Group having to deal with a letter?

definitions.text: Group having to deal with a letter?

parts.words: Group having to deal with a letter?
parts.note: a letter here is one who lets property, a landlord, and those renting deal with one

explanation.surface: A team must handle some correspondence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letter' looks like mail but means someone who lets out property.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenantry is the body of tenants on an estate, who all rent from a landlord.

clue.text: Mockery making one Christian organisation weary

parts.note: SA is the Salvation Army, a Christian organisation
to weary someone is to tire them

explanation.surface: Ridicule wears down a church charity.
explanation.definitionFit: Satire uses ridicule and irony to mock its targets.
